criterionOutcomes.criterion: After opening GIS and loading an available Surveyor layer, the layer legend displays a Display Settings control.
criterionOutcomes.reason: The Surveyor - Service legend shows the Display Settings control.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Opening Display Settings displays a Show linked sites control with an identifiable checked or unchecked initial state.
criterionOutcomes.reason: Display Settings shows Show linked sites checked.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Changing Show linked sites to the opposite state visibly changes the control to that new checked or unchecked state.
criterionOutcomes.reason: The criterion screenshots show Show linked sites checked before the toggle and unchecked after it.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Restoring Show linked sites to its initial state, closing and reopening Display Settings, displays the same initial state.
criterionOutcomes.reason: The screenshots show checked, then unchecked, restored to checked, closed, and checked again after reopening.
